prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: individual collectible military medal icon for a Japanese stealth tank game. One single medal, centered front view, entire hanging ribbon and pendant fully visible, square canvas with 8% transparent margin. Premium stylized game illustration with sculpted metal relief, bold readable emblem, subtle bevels and tactile woven ribbon. Consistent graphic design: short folded ribbon at top, small suspension ring, large circular pendant with octagonal outer rim and restrained laurel trim. Studio light from upper left, polished highlights, no cast shadow outside the object. Icon must read at 64px. No letters, text, numerals, logos, flags, background scene, or extra badges. Background truly transparent.

titles.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: supreme MYTHIC collectible achievement emblem for a Japanese stealth tank game, title 'Myth of the Battlefield'. Generate ONE premium full-color game UI award emblem, not a sheet. Centered front view, square canvas, true transparent background, 10% transparent breathing room around every edge. NO RIBBON, no woven fabric, no hanging strap or suspension loop, no banner, no text or letters. The central clear hero motif is a squat circular BLACK planted demolition mine, a round black metal disk with radial ridges and one prominent glowing RUBY RED domed central button, shown with enough slight top view to read as a planted bomb rather than a sphere. Surround the mine with an exceptionally lavish symmetrical gold and platinum radial order-of-merit star, sculpted laurel leaves, elegant gold filigree and faceted RAINBOW gemstone inlays: vivid sapphire blue, emerald green, violet amethyst, ruby red, turquoise and amber. Iridescent opal accents, brilliant but restrained colored light reflections, regal jewel-like craftsmanship, colorful highest-rank legendary fantasy military award. Keep the black-and-red mine unmistakable and large, occupying the central 45% of the emblem. Polished stylized sculpted metallic relief, crisp strong silhouette and readable at 80px, studio light from upper left. The emblem occupies an approximately square overall footprint. All decorative rays and gems are attached to the emblem; no detached floating particles, no background scene, no background glow, no flags, no weapons other than the central demolition mine. No ribbon of any sort.
